name: Sun Cleric: Faith refreshes on any direct heal, even at full health (#4574)
contract: Faith 707077 (proc trigger, spell_proc rev_20260909_13_sun_cleric_completion.sql:39, 100% chance) casts the armor buff 804405 on Check() success. Its own tooltip reads 'Direct healing done now increases the target's Armor by ...' (coa-dbc-viewer record --id 707077 against /home/fab/CoaServer/dbc_clientset) -- 'healing done', with no health-threshold or effective-healing qualifier; 804405's own tooltip is likewise unconditional. AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp's Check() gated case 707077 on the shared `healing` variable, which is event.GetHealInfo()->GetEffectiveHeal() (zero on an already-full-health target, i.e. pure overheal), so a full-health heal never refreshed 804405. Fix reads event.GetHealInfo()->GetHeal() (the raw/attempted heal) for the 707077 branch only, leaving 704563 (Warmth, not reported here) on the shared effective-heal variable. Asserts a direct heal on a full-health ally still applies Faith.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Faith applies despite the heal overhealing
